request.style: English, gentle chamber folk, warm clear female vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, viola, flute, light hand percussion, thoughtful and hopeful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
At Gibeon in the night the LORD came in a dream
To a young king newly crowned and not yet sure of anything
Ask what I should give you, said the LORD to Solomon
And the king looked at his hands, still a boy and not a man

[Verse]
You were kind to David, my father, all his days
And you set his son upon his throne to walk in all his ways
But I am only a young man, I don't know how to go out or come in
Among a people so numerous they cannot be counted in

[Chorus]
Give your servant a listening heart
To judge your people
To discern between good and evil
Not for gold and not for years
Give me ears to hear

[Verse]
It pleased the LORD that Solomon had asked for this alone
Not for riches, not long life, not for enemies overthrown
I give you a heart so wise and discerning, said the LORD
And what you did not ask for, riches and honor, I will pour

[Chorus]
Give your servant a listening heart
To judge your people
To discern between good and evil
Not for gold and not for years
Give me ears to hear

[Bridge]
If you walk in my ways
Keeping my statutes and my commandments
As your father David walked
I will lengthen your days

[Chorus]
Give your servant a listening heart
To discern between good and evil
Give me ears to hear
